about.en: OCEAN is the token of Ocean Protocol, a decentralized data-sharing and compute ecosystem that tokenizes access to datasets and AI services. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x967da4048cd07ab37855c090aaf366e4ce1b9f48. In 2024 OCEAN joined the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance token merger with Fetch.ai and SingularityNET; Ocean Protocol left the alliance in 2025 and OCEAN continues to trade as its own token.
